svg.title: l27sen / binary alter ego
svg.desc: Lahsen wearing glasses, rendered entirely in animated zeros and ones that dissolve into 27. Cybersecurity engineering student focused on reverse engineering and binary analysis. Hobbies include XOR and PRNG checks, heap use-after-free and GOT overwrites, JWT algorithm confusion, and local LLMs. Advanced CTF practice on Hack The Box and Root-Me.
